heading.zh-Hant: 軍官出身的電機工程師

body.zh-Hant: 特尼斯是工程師，也是無黨籍的天主教政治人物。他起初是職業軍官，1897年起改學電機工程，之後成為金融家恩潘男爵的合作者；1914年他又重新入伍。
body.en: Theunis was an engineer and an independent Catholic politician. He began as a professional officer, turned to electrical engineering studies in 1897, and then worked with the financier Baron Empain; in 1914 he returned to military service.

citations.quote: ingenieur en onafhankelijk katholiek politicus
Hij was eerst beroepsofficier en ging toen (1897)
elektrotechniek studeren
Hij werd medewerker van de financier baron Empain
maar nam in 1914 opnieuw dienst in het leger

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時駐倫敦代表與財政部長
heading.en: Wartime envoy in London and finance minister

body.zh-Hant: 安特衛普陷落後，他擔任政府駐倫敦的代表，並參與凡爾賽條約的談判。兩次大戰之間，他於1920至1925年任財政部長，1932年任國防部長；1925至1926年又以增選方式出任參議員。他兩度出任首相：1921年12月至1925年5月，以及1934年11月至1935年3月（任期已在名單，此處不另建）。
body.en: After the fall of Antwerp he represented the government in London and took part in the negotiations on the Treaty of Versailles. Between the wars he was finance minister (1920 to 1925) and minister of defence (1932), and from 1925 to 1926 he sat as a co-opted senator. He was prime minister twice, from December 1921 to May 1925 and from November 1934 to March 1935 (already in the roster, so not rebuilt here).

citations.quote: was hij vertegenwoordiger van de regering te Londen
over het verdrag van Versailles
minister van Financiën (1920-’25)
en van Landsverdediging (1932)
tweemaal eerste minister (december 1921-mei ’25; november 1934-maart ’35)
Van 1925 tot ’26 was hij gecoöpteerd senator.
Na de val van Ant­ werpen
Tussen de twee oorlogen was hij minister van Financiën

heading.zh-Hant: 首相任內與佛拉芒語言問題
heading.en: Premierships and the Flemish language question

body.zh-Hant: 1921年政府聲明中，特尼斯請眾議院自行對高等教育荷語化採取主動。1923年中他宣布提出讓根特大學成為雙語的法案，通過後促成所謂的諾爾夫大學，佛拉芒運動人士並不滿意。1924年2至3月，因一項法比貿易條約草案遭否決，再度發生政府危機。他第二次任首相期間（1934至1935年）設立了戈迪恩委員會。
body.en: In his 1921 government declaration Theunis asked the Chamber itself to take the initiative on the Dutch-language reform of higher education. In 1923 he announced a bill making the University of Ghent bilingual; it led to the so-called Nolf university, with which the Flemish activists were unhappy. A new government crisis in February–March 1924 followed the rejection of a draft Franco-Belgian trade treaty. During his second premiership (1934 to 1935) the Goddijn Commission was set up.

van de zg. Nolf-universiteit tot gevolg

waarmee de flaminganten niet gelukkig waren
In februari­ maart 1924 vond een nieuwe regeringscrisis plaats
tweede periode van eerste ministerschap

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時特使與國家銀行總裁
heading.en: Wartime envoy and governor of the National Bank

body.zh-Hant: 1935年特尼斯離開政界，回到民間能源產業。1939至1944年他擔任派駐美國的特命大使（特別任務）；克隆布瓦的研究提到，這項赴美任務由前首相特尼斯率領，他並擔任利奧波德三世對羅斯福的私人代表。1941年11月27日，他在倫敦被部長會議任命為國家銀行總裁，不領薪水，1944年11月4日離任。
body.en: In 1935 Theunis left politics to return to the private energy sector. From 1939 to 1944 he was extraordinary ambassador on a special mission in the United States; Crombois notes that the mission to the United States was led by the former prime minister Theunis, who was also King Leopold III's personal representative to President Roosevelt. On 27 November 1941 the Council of Ministers appointed him governor of the National Bank in London, unpaid; he left on 4 November 1944.

people.name: František Udržal
people.nameZh: 弗朗蒂舍克·烏德爾扎爾

body.zh-Hant: 烏德爾扎爾1866年1月3日生於多尼羅韋尼，出身東波希米亞的古老農家。他在帕爾杜比采與摩拉維亞特熱博瓦就讀實科學校，1886年夏天從塔博爾農業學院畢業，中學時期即擔任索科爾體操協會教練。他後來在哈雷讀了兩個學期農業高校，並在佩斯服一年志願兵役，之後在施泰爾馬克的馬里博爾替親戚管理莊園三年，1895年返鄉接掌家傳莊園。
body.en: Udržal was born on 3 January 1866 in Dolní Roveň, into an old East Bohemian peasant family. He attended the Realschule in Pardubice and Moravská Třebová and graduated from the agricultural academy in Tábor in the summer of 1886; he was already a Sokol instructor as a schoolboy. He then spent two semesters at the agricultural college in Halle, served as a one-year volunteer in Pest, managed a relative's estate in Maribor for three years, and in 1895 returned home to take over the family farm.

citations.quote: 3. leden 1866 (Dolní Roveň)
Pocházel ze starodávného východočeského selského rodu.
Studoval na Městské reálce v Pardubicích a Moravské Třebové
kterou absolvoval v létě 1886
Již během středoškolských studií působil jako cvičitel Sokola
Po maturitě absolvoval dva semestry Vysoké školy zemědělské v Halle
jako jednoroční dobrovolník vojenskou presenční službu v Pešti
Tři roky působil jako správce statku jednoho ze svých příbuzných
ale roku 1895 se vrátil definitivně domů a převzal rodný statek
přestoupil na Zemědělskou akademii v Táboře
jednoho ze svých příbuzných ve Štýrském Mariboru

heading.zh-Hant: 奧匈帝國時期的議員生涯

body.zh-Hant: 1896年他創立當地的農民協會並加入自由思想民族黨，1897年以該黨身分當選帝國議會議員，次年又進入波希米亞邦議會。1906年他轉入捷克農民黨，1907年再度當選帝國議會議員，議會工作著重軍事事務。一戰爆發後，他推動捷克議員組成捷克聯盟並任副主席；1917年5月帝國議會恢復運作後，任眾議院副議長。
body.en: In 1896 he founded the local peasants' association and joined the National Liberal Party, for which he was elected to the Imperial Council in 1897 and to the Bohemian Diet a year later. In 1906 he joined the Czech Agrarian Party and in 1907 was again elected to the Imperial Council, focusing on military matters. After the war broke out he initiated the unification of Czech deputies in the Czech Union and became its vice-chairman; in May 1917, once the Imperial Council resumed work, he became vice-president of its lower house.

citations.quote: v roce 1896 založil místní Selskou jednotu
vstoupil do Národní strany svobodomyslné
za kterou byl roku 1897 zvolen poslancem Říšské rady
a o rok později také do českého zemského sněmu
v roce 1906 se stal členem České strany agrární
O rok později byl opět zvolen poslancem Říšské rady
Svoji poslaneckou činnost zaměřil na vojenské záležitosti

Po vypuknutí první světové války inicioval sjednocení českých poslanců
jehož se stal místopředsedou

heading.zh-Hant: 建國初期與國防委員會
heading.en: Founding years and the defence committee

body.zh-Hant: 1918年7月，烏德爾扎爾成為捷克斯洛伐克民族委員會成員，獨立宣布後主持其國防委員會，參與最初的「本土軍」部隊的建立，並推動軍隊占領邊境地區。他其後成為革命國民議會副主席兼國防委員會主席（來源所載年份明顯誤植，未採用）；1920年5月成為國民議會議員，並任眾議院國防委員會主席，推動基本軍事立法。
body.en: In July 1918 Udržal became a member of the Czechoslovak National Committee. After independence was declared he led its defence committee, took part in forming the first units of the so-called home army, and pushed through the military occupation of the border regions. He then became vice-chairman of the Revolutionary National Assembly and chairman of its defence committee (the source's year for this is evidently misprinted and is not used); in May 1920 he became a member of the National Assembly and chairman of the Chamber's defence committee, helping to enact the basic military legislation.

citations.quote: V červenci 1918 se stal členem Národního výboru československého
po vyhlášení samostatnosti vedl jeho branný výbor
podílel se na vzniku prvních jednotek tzv. domácího vojska
prosadil vojenské obsazení pohraničí
stal se jeho místopředsedou a také předsedou branného výboru
V květnu 1920 se stal poslancem Národního shromáždění
a předsedou branného výboru poslanecké sněmovny
podílel se na prosazení základního vojenského zákonodárství
byl jmenován poslancem Revolučního národního shromáždění

body.zh-Hant: 1921年9月他出任國防部長，任職到1925年12月，1926年10月再任，到1929年9月。他反對軍隊依賴外國模式，推動降低法國軍事使團的地位、使其成為諮詢機構；同時堅定主張強化與法國及小協約國的同盟體系，並支持外長貝奈斯。他與總統馬薩里克在軍隊指揮問題上多次衝突，並與總統合作使軍隊去政治化，包括取消軍人的選舉權。
body.en: He was appointed Minister of National Defence in September 1921 and served until December 1925, and again from October 1926 to September 1929. He opposed the army's dependence on foreign models and pushed through a gradual reduction of the French Military Mission's importance, turning it into an advisory body; at the same time he consistently argued for strengthening the alliance system with France and the Little Entente, backing Minister Beneš. He clashed with President Masaryk several times over command of the armed forces, and with the president's help depoliticised the military, including removing soldiers' voting rights.

citations.quote: V září 1921 byl jmenován ministrem národní obrany
v této funkci působil do prosince 1925
opětovně od října 1926 do září 1929
Patřil mezi odpůrce závislosti armády na zahraničních vzorech
a její přeměnu v poradní orgán
zasazoval o posílení spojeneckého systému s Francií
přičemž v těchto záležitostech podporoval ministra Beneše
s presidentem Masarykem se několikrát střetl
důsledné odpolitizování branné moci včetně odebrání volebního práva vojákům
prosadil postupné snížení významu Francouzské vojenské mise
i se zeměmi Malé dohody
opět ve spolupráci s presidentem republiky

body.zh-Hant: 1929年2月，他接替重病的施韋拉出任總理，但受到布拉格城堡（總統府）的強烈影響；1929年12月總統以命令任命新政府，他把右翼政府改組為包含少數民族代表的民族聯合政府，並在12月13日宣讀施政綱領。1932年10月他因健康理由辭職，專心黨的執行委員會工作。1935年5月他當選國民議會參議員，1937年12月放棄議席。
body.en: In February 1929 he took over as prime minister from the gravely ill Antonín Švehla but fell under strong influence from the Castle (the presidency). The president appointed a new government by decree in December 1929, which he turned from a right-wing cabinet into a national coalition including representatives of the national minorities, and he presented its programme on 13 December. In October 1932 he resigned for health reasons and concentrated on the party's executive committee; in May 1935 he was elected a senator, giving up the seat in December 1937.

heading.en: Origins, law practice and the Labour Party

body.zh-Hant: 斯特蘭德曼1875年11月30日生於維魯馬的萬杜村新校舍。1903至1905年他在塔林擔任律師，並在1905年革命中擔任參與者的辯護人。1917年春天，他與尤里·維爾姆斯共同創立愛沙尼亞激進社會黨，同年秋天該黨改名為愛沙尼亞工黨。1917年他曾任塔林地區法院檢察官。
body.en: Strandman was born on 30 November 1875 in the new school building of Vandu village in Virumaa. He worked as an advocate in Tallinn from 1903 to 1905 and was notable as a defender of participants in the 1905 revolution. In spring 1917, alongside Jüri Vilms, he was one of the founders of the Estonian Radical Socialist Party, renamed the Estonian Labour Party in the autumn of that year. In 1917 he was also a prosecutor at the Tallinn district court.

body.zh-Hant: 1917至1918年，斯特蘭德曼擔任地方議會（Maanõukogu）議長，1917至1919年為其議員。1918年夏秋他在帕茨領導的第一屆臨時政府擔任外交部長，並留任第二屆臨時政府；1918年11月27日起的第三屆臨時政府中，他任農業部長，到1919年5月8日。1919至1920年，他是制憲會議議員。
body.en: From 1917 to 1918 Strandman chaired the Land Council (Maanõukogu), of which he was a member from 1917 to 1919. In summer and autumn 1918 he was foreign minister in Konstantin Päts's first provisional government and remained so in the second; in the third provisional government, which took office on 27 November 1918, he was minister of agriculture until 8 May 1919. From 1919 to 1920 he was a member of the Constituent Assembly.

heading.en: Prime minister and minister of war

body.zh-Hant: 1919年，斯特蘭德曼出任總理兼戰爭部長；他領導的政府是第一個從直接選出的制憲會議取得授權的愛沙尼亞政府。他任內經歷獨立戰爭，包括在北拉脫維亞與地方防衛軍（Landeswehr）作戰，以及6月19至23日的溫諾戰役；他的政府也推動了激進的土地改革。總理任期已在名單，此處不另建。
body.en: In 1919 Strandman was prime minister and also minister of war; his government was the first Estonian government to receive its mandate directly from the popularly elected Constituent Assembly. His premiership fell in the War of Independence, including the fighting against the Landeswehr in northern Latvia and the Battle of Võnnu on 19 to 23 June, and his government carried out a radical land reform. The premiership itself is already in the roster and is not rebuilt here.

heading.en: Foreign minister, Riigikogu chairman and finance minister

body.zh-Hant: 1920年10月26日起，他在皮普領導的政府擔任外交兼司法部長，到1921年1月14日。他是第一屆國會（Riigikogu）議員，並在1921年擔任其第一位議長。1923年他揭露和平條約所得的黃金儲備被耗盡；1924年在阿克爾政府先任外交部長，5月14日起改任財政部長，透過讓貨幣與黃金掛鉤，避免國家破產。
body.en: From 26 October 1920 he was foreign and justice minister in Ants Piip's government, until 14 January 1921. He sat in the first Riigikogu and in 1921 was its first chairman. In 1923 he exposed that the gold reserves obtained under the Tartu peace treaty were being spent down; in Friedrich Akel's government in 1924 he was first foreign minister and from 14 May finance minister, and by putting the currency on a gold basis he managed to avert state bankruptcy.

body.zh-Hant: 1927至1929年，斯特蘭德曼出任愛沙尼亞駐波蘭、捷克斯洛伐克與羅馬尼亞公使。1929年7月9日他領導的政府上任，任期584天，到1931年2月12日；政府任內面對憲法危機，1930年2月他正式訪問波蘭，1931年2月3日宣布政府總辭。1931至1932年他是第四、第五屆國會議員。
body.en: From 1927 to 1929 Strandman was Estonian envoy to Poland, Czechoslovakia and Romania. The government he led took office on 9 July 1929 and lasted 584 days, until 12 February 1931; it faced a constitutional crisis, he made an official visit to Poland in February 1930, and on 3 February 1931 he announced the government's resignation. In 1931 to 1932 he sat in the fourth and fifth Riigikogu. The State Elder term itself is already in the roster.

body.zh-Hant: 1933至1939年，斯特蘭德曼擔任愛沙尼亞駐法國、西班牙、比利時與梵蒂岡公使。1939年他因健康惡化決定退出公共生活，退居卡德里納。收到前往內務人民委員部（NKVD）報到的傳喚後，他在1941年2月5日自盡，2月7日葬於塔林希林納墓園。
body.en: From 1933 to 1939 Strandman was Estonian envoy to France, Spain, Belgium and the Vatican. In 1939, because of failing health, he decided to withdraw from public life and settled in Kadrina. After being summoned to report to the NKVD, he took his own life on 5 February 1941 and was buried on 7 February at the Siselinna cemetery in Tallinn.
